title: 第 19章 扶木之术入门第 20章 狼妖
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 窗外雪落无声。
沈回坐在床沿，就着悬在半空的火焰，把那《扶木篇》翻来覆去看了好几遍。
帛书上说，扶木之术能延年益寿。
这话他第一遍就注意到了，毕竟谁不想多活几年呢？
可越往下看，他越觉得这门法术没那么简单。
“木主生发，故能催发生机；木主风，故能引动气流；木主雷，故能行使雷法。”
他盯着这行字，眉头渐渐皱起来。
这是三种不同的方向，还是三个递进的层次？
催发生机，是滋养自身，延年益寿。
引动气流，是呼风之术，能影响外界。
行雷法……那是杀伐手段了，与火法不同，毕竟雷是用来劈的。
若真能三者兼得，那这扶木之术的价值，怕是比他想象的要大得多。
他试着按帛书上说的法子，闭目内观，感应那一缕“木气”。
胸口那团火还是火，暖烘烘的，安稳得很。
可那“木气”该是什么感觉？
帛书上说“如春风拂面，如嫩芽破土”，沈回在心头揣摩了半天，只觉得春风是春风，嫩芽是嫩芽，跟自己半点关系也无。
他睁开眼，叹了口气。
天赋这玩意儿，果然骗不了人。
火法他能自己悟出来，那是因为他与那“性火”之说天然契合。
可这木法……他一个穿越过来的外来户，上辈子连多肉都养不活，哪来的“生发”之性？
试了一夜。
窗外雪停了又下，下了又停。
那缕“木气”愣是没感应到分毫。最多就是心口里那团火偶尔跳一跳，像是在嘲笑他。
天快亮的时候，他终于放弃了。
“行吧。”
他低声嘀咕，“该省省，该花花。”
念头一动，唤出那羊皮纸界面。
【是否消耗100道行点数，学习小五行法·扶木篇（入门）？】
是。
一股清流凭空而生。
不似火法那种热腾腾的暖流，一股清凉绵长之气缓缓从头顶上浇了下来。
那清流涌入四肢百骸，涌入每一寸血肉，每一根骨头。
沈回闭上眼，沉浸在那股清凉里。
不知过了多久，他睁开眼，只觉得浑身轻快，连呼吸都比之前顺畅了几分。
他下意识看向界面，扶木之术那一栏已经亮了起来，下面密密麻麻多了一串小字。
【扶木之术（入门）】
【注解】：修习此法需蓄养毛发，不可轻剃，以应木气生发之象。
【功效】：
content_en:
Snow fell silently outside the window.
Shen Hui sat on the edge of the bed and read "The Armrest Chapter" over and over several times with the flames hanging in the air.
Silk books say that the technique of supporting trees can prolong life.
He noticed this the first time he said it. After all, who doesn't want to live a few more years?
But the more he looked down, the more he felt that this spell was not that simple.
"Wood controls hair, so it can stimulate vitality; wood controls wind, so it can induce airflow; wood controls thunder, so it can perform thunder methods."
He stared at this line of words, his brows gradually furrowed.
Are these three different directions, or three progressive levels?
Promoting vitality means nourishing oneself and prolonging life.
Inducing airflow is the art of breathing wind, which can affect the outside world.
The thunder method... is a killing method. It is different from the fire method. After all, thunder is used to chop.
If he could really achieve all three, then the value of this supporting tree technique would be much greater than he imagined.
He tried to follow the method described in the silk book, closed his eyes and looked inside, sensing the wisp of "wood energy".
The fire in my chest was still fire, warm and stable.
But what does "wood energy" feel like?
The silk book said, "It's like the spring breeze blowing on the face, like the buds breaking through the soil." Shen Hui thought about it in his mind for a long time. He just felt that the spring breeze was the spring breeze and the buds were just buds, and it had nothing to do with him.
He opened his eyes and sighed.
Talent really can't be fooled.
He was able to understand the fire method on his own because he was naturally consistent with the theory of "fire nature".
But this Mufa... He is a foreigner who has traveled through time. In his previous life, he couldn't even feed himself with meat. How could he have the ability to "grow hair"?
Tried it all night.
Outside the window, the snow stopped and fell, and then stopped again.
I didn't feel the "wood energy" at all. At most, the fire in his heart would jump occasionally, as if it was mocking him.
As daybreak approached, he finally gave up.
"Okay."
He muttered in a low voice, "It's time to save money, and it's time to spend money."
With a thought, he summoned the parchment interface.
[Would you like to spend 100 Dao Xing points to learn the Small Five Elements Method·Fumu Chapter (Introduction)? 】
yes.
A stream of clear water emerged out of thin air.
Unlike the steaming warmth of the fire method, a cool and long-lasting air slowly poured down from the top of the head.
The clear flow poured into the limbs and bones, into every inch of flesh and blood, and every bone.
Shen Hui closed his eyes and immersed himself in the coolness.
After an unknown amount of time, he opened his eyes and felt light all over his body, and even his breathing was a little easier than before.
He subconsciously looked at the interface and saw that the column for Supporting Wood Techniques had lit up, with a series of small words densely packed underneath.
[The Art of Supporting Trees (Introduction)]
[Note]: To practice this method, you need to grow your hair and do not shave it lightly to cope with the phenomenon of wood-qi hair growth.
